item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: scheduled-price
item.description: 2026-12-01: Posted standard rates rise to $4 input / $20 output per million tokens; cached input $0.20. Batch, Flex and Priority rates also double. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

item.title: The supermodel’s introductory rate
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon has a rate card for next season already. Its posted token prices double on 1 December.
